headline: Free shipping now turns on by default, which can remove shipping charges for every order.
what_changed: Customers will receive free shipping on all orders unless the company adds a setting that explicitly turns it off.
The checkout's existing minimum-order rule still applies only when free shipping is turned off.
Shipping settings are now grouped with other company settings.

risks.title: Shipping charges removed by default
risks.explanation: Before this change, free shipping only applied when the company explicitly enabled it. After this change, it applies whenever the setting is missing, which is likely in normal non-promotion periods. This would waive shipping charges on every checkout and reduce revenue until someone adds an explicit setting to turn it off.

questions_for_developer: Was the intention to make free shipping the normal default for every order? If not, please keep it off unless the company explicitly turns it on.
good_news: The change is small and affects the shipping calculation in one place.
